rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第四条 住院医疗保险责任：在保险期间内，被保险人因遭受意外伤害或在等待期（30天）后罹患疾病，经中华人民共和国境内二级以上公立医院普通部诊断必须住院治疗的，本公司就其合理且必要的住院医疗费用，在扣除人民币650元免赔额后，按100%给付住院医疗保险金，累计给付金额以40万元人民币为限。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 4 Inpatient Medical Insurance Liability: During the insurance period, if the insured suffers accidental injury or falls ill after the 30-day waiting period and requires hospitalization diagnosed by a public hospital Class 2 or above in mainland China, the company will reimburse 100% of reasonable and necessary inpatient medical expenses exceeding the RMB 650 deductible, up to a cumulative maximum of RMB 400,000.

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第五条 门急诊医疗保险责任：被保险人因遭受意外伤害或在等待期后罹患疾病，在二级及以上公立医院门诊或急诊接受治疗的，门急诊医疗费用累计达到免赔额650元以上的部分，本公司按85%的比例给付保险金。门诊日限额为人民币600元，保险期间内累计给付金额以2万元为限。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 5 Outpatient and Emergency Medical Benefit: For outpatient or emergency care at Class 2 or above public hospitals due to accident or illness after waiting period, the company reimburses 85% of eligible expenses exceeding the RMB 650 deductible. The daily outpatient reimbursement cap is RMB 600, and the cumulative maximum per policy year is RMB 20,000.
rag_chunks_cn.topic: Outpatient Emergency Benefit, Deductible, and Coinsurance

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第七条 责任免除：因下列情形之一导致被保险人支出医疗费用的，本公司不承担给付保险金责任：（一）被保险人在投保前已罹患的既往症、先天性畸形及遗传性疾病；（二）在公立医院特需医疗部、国际部、外宾病房或私立诊所发生的医疗费用；（三）整容、矫形、视力矫正及非意外牙科治疗。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 7 Exclusions: The company is not liable for medical expenses arising from: (1) Pre-existing conditions, congenital malformations, and hereditary diseases existing prior to policy inception; (2) Treatment received in public hospital VIP departments, international wings, foreign guest wards, or private clinics; (3) Cosmetic surgery, orthopedics, vision correction, and non-accidental dental treatment.
rag_chunks_cn.topic: Policy Exclusions: Pre-existing Conditions and Private Facilities

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 深圳大学国际学生入学须知：根据教育部规定，来华留学生必须在入学报到前购买‘来华留学生综合医疗保险’。未购买指定保险者，学校不予办理学籍注册及签证延期手续。保险期间须覆盖在校整个学习周期。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Shenzhen University International Student Registration Notice: Pursuant to Ministry of Education regulations, international students must purchase the Comprehensive Insurance & Protection Scheme for Foreigners Staying in China prior to enrollment. Students who fail to purchase will not be registered or assisted with visa extension. Insurance must cover the full study period.

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第二条 重大疾病保险金：被保险人经医院确诊初次发生本主险合同约定的重大疾病（共120种），且此前未发生本主险合同约定的特定轻度重疾或中症重疾的，我们按基本保险金额给付重大疾病保险金，本主险合同终止。等待期为90天。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 2 Critical Illness Insurance Benefit: If the insured is diagnosed for the first time by an accredited hospital with one of the 120 critical illnesses defined in this policy contract, we pay 100% of the basic sum insured (RMB 500,000) as critical illness benefit, and the policy terminates. Waiting period is 90 days.
rag_chunks_cn.topic: Critical Illness 120 Conditions Lump Sum Benefit

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第三条 重大疾病保险金责任：被保险人于本合同生效之日起一百八十日后，经本公司认可的医院确诊初次发生本合同所指的重大疾病（共100种），本公司按基本保险金额给付重大疾病保险金，本合同终止。若因意外伤害导致上述情形的，无等待期限制。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 3 Critical Illness Benefit: If the insured is diagnosed after 180 days from the policy effective date with one of the 100 defined major illnesses, the company pays 100% sum insured (RMB 500,000). If caused by accident, no waiting period applies.
rag_chunks_cn.topic: 100 Severe Diseases Waiting Period and Lump Sum

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第二条 身故保险金：被保险人于本合同生效或最后复效之日起九十日后因疾病导致身故，或因意外伤害导致身故，本公司按基本保险金额给付身故保险金（100万元人民币），本合同终止。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 2 Death Benefit: If the insured dies due to illness after 90 days from policy inception or due to accidental injury at any time, the company pays the full basic sum insured (RMB 1,000,000), and the policy terminates.
rag_chunks_cn.topic: Term Life Death Benefit and Accidental Death

rag_chunks_cn.provenance_note: Illustrative clause text with developer-authored clause and page labels. Not a retrieved policy quotation.
rag_chunks_cn.original_source_text: 第三条 意外伤害身故及残疾保险金：在保险期间内，被保险人遭受意外伤害事故，并自事故发生之日起一百八十日内因该事故身故的，本公司按意外伤害保险金额给付身故保险金。因该事故导致残疾的，按比例给付伤残保险金。等待期为0天。
rag_chunks_cn.english_translation: Article 3 Accidental Death and Disability Benefit: If the insured suffers an accident and dies within 180 days or incurs disability graded under the national standard, benefit is paid up to RMB 500,000. Waiting period is 0 days.

rag_chunks_id.original_source_text: Peraturan Presiden No. 59 Tahun 2024 Pasal 46 ayat (1): Pelayanan kesehatan rujukan tingkat lanjutan rawat inap dilaksanakan pada Fasilitas Kesehatan yang menerapkan kriteria Kelas Rawat Inap Standar (KRIS) JKN yang menjamin kecukupan tempat tidur, sirkulasi udara, pencahayaan, dan kamar mandi dalam.
rag_chunks_id.english_translation: Presidential Regulation No. 59 Year 2024 Article 46 paragraph (1): Inpatient advanced referral healthcare is implemented at facilities applying the Standard Inpatient Class (KRIS) criteria of JKN, ensuring adequate bedding, air ventilation, lighting, and internal bathrooms.

Healthcare obtained without tiered referral from FKTP, except in medical emergencies; f. Healthcare for aesthetic/cosmetic purposes; h. Infertility treatment; r. Medical treatment outside Indonesia.

Emergency criteria encompass life-threatening conditions or acute risks of permanent disability.

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: The predetermined amount of eligible expenses that the policyholder must pay out of pocket before the insurer begins paying benefits.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Jumlah biaya awal yang harus dibayar oleh pemegang polis sendiri sebelum perusahaan asuransi mulai membayar manfaat klaim.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 在保险公司按约定比例赔付前，由被保险人自行承担的法定或合同约定免赔金额。

country_specific_notes.CN: In China international student insurance (lxbx.net), outpatient medical has an annual deductible of RMB 650, and inpatient has an incident deductible of RMB 650.
country_specific_notes.ID: In Indonesian commercial health insurance, deductibles are often applied to high-tier plans to lower monthly premiums (e.g. IDR 10jt to 25jt per year).

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: NFRA Insurance Terms Standard & OJK Financial Consumer Dictionary

multilingual_glossary.simplified_chinese: 自付比例 / 自负比例
multilingual_glossary.definition_en: A fixed dollar amount or percentage that the insured person pays for a covered healthcare service after the deductible.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Jumlah tetap atau persentase tertentu yang dibayar oleh peserta asuransi setiap kali menerima layanan medis yang dijamin.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 被保险人在获得保险责任范围内的医疗服务时，自行按比例或固定金额分摊支付的医疗费用。

country_specific_notes.CN: In mainland China public healthcare, patients pay a statutory copayment percentage depending on the hospital tier (Class 1, 2, or 3).
country_specific_notes.ID: In Indonesian private health insurance, copayment typically ranges from 10% to 20% on specific outpatient or pharmacy claims.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: NFRA and OJK Consumer Protection Glossary

multilingual_glossary.indonesian: Kondisi yang Sudah Ada Sebelumnya (Pre-existing Condition)
multilingual_glossary.definition_en: A medical condition, injury, or illness diagnosed, treated, or exhibiting known symptoms prior to policy effective date.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Kondisi medis, cedera, atau penyakit yang telah terdiagnosis, diobati, atau menunjukkan gejala sebelum tanggal berlakunya polis asuransi.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 在保险合同生效日前已由医生明确确诊、接受过治疗，或已有明显临床症状的既往疾病或健康损害。

country_specific_notes.CN: Ping An international student insurance explicitly excludes all pre-existing conditions and congenital diseases diagnosed prior to registration.
country_specific_notes.ID: BPJS Kesehatan does NOT exclude pre-existing conditions, while commercial Indonesian private insurers enforce waiting periods or underwriting exclusions.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: Insurance Law of the PRC Article 16 & Indonesian Insurance Code

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: The period of time after policy inception during which benefits are not payable for specified medical events or illnesses.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Jangka waktu tertentu setelah polis mulai berlaku di mana manfaat asuransi belum dapat diklaim untuk penyakit tertentu.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 自保险合同生效日起计算的一定期间（通常为30天至1年），在此期间内发生的非意外疾病，保险公司不承担给付责任。

country_specific_notes.CN: China commercial health insurance typically applies a 30-day waiting period for illness and 90 to 180 days for critical illnesses. Accidental injuries have 0 waiting period.
country_specific_notes.ID: Indonesian health insurance enforces a 30-day waiting period for general illness and 12-month waiting period for 18 specific illnesses (penyakit khusus).

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: A payment facility where the hospital bills the insurer or third-party administrator directly without the patient paying out of pocket first.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Fasilitas di mana rumah sakit rekanan menagihkan biaya perawatan langsung kepada perusahaan asuransi atau TPA tanpa pasien harus membayar tunai terlebih dahulu.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 被保险人在定点医疗机构就医时，属于保险责任范围内的费用由保险公司直接与医疗机构结算，患者无需先行垫付资金。

country_specific_notes.CN: In China, basic social health insurance uses real-time direct settlement via the Digital Medical Insurance Card (医保电子凭证). Commercial cashless is common in high-end international wings.
country_specific_notes.ID: In Indonesia, JKN BPJS Kesehatan operates entirely cashless with SEP at partner hospitals. Commercial insurers provide cashless cards through TPAs like AdMedika.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: NHSA Direct Settlement Protocol & AAJI Cashless Standards

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: The claim method where the policyholder settles medical bills directly with the provider, then submits receipts and medical evidence to the insurer for compensation.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Metode klaim di mana tertanggung membayar sendiri seluruh tagihan di rumah sakit terlebih dahulu, kemudian mengajukan kuitansi asli kepada penanggung untuk penggantian.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 被保险人自行先向医疗机构全额垫付费用，治疗结束后持发票、明细和病历向保险公司申请审核给付已发生的合理费用。

country_specific_notes.CN: Ping An international student insurance uses the reimbursement model: students pay the hospital, obtain official fapiao, and submit online via lxbx.net.
country_specific_notes.ID: Used for non-partner hospitals or when cashless card facilities are offline, requiring original stamped kwitansi and doctor's resume medis.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: NFRA and OJK Consumer Protection Rules

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: The state-certified fiscal electronic or paper invoice issued by licensed hospitals in China, containing national fiscal verification codes and official seal.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Faktur keuangan resmi terverifikasi yang diterbitkan oleh rumah sakit berlisensi di Tiongkok dengan stempel fiskal dan kode verifikasi nasional.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 由国家财政部和税务总局统一监制、由公立医疗机构出具的具有法定效力的医疗门急诊或住院专用财政收费凭据。

country_specific_notes.CN: Mandatory proof for all insurance reimbursement in mainland China. Electronic fapiao (电子票据) can be verified on official provincial fiscal portals.
country_specific_notes.ID: Equivalent in Indonesia is Kuitansi Resmi Rumah Sakit bermeterai dengan stempel kasir dan rincian biaya resmi.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: Ministry of Finance of the PRC Hospital Fiscal Invoice Standards

multilingual_glossary.definition_en: A structured clinical coordination system where patients must be initially examined by primary healthcare providers before accessing specialized hospital care.
multilingual_glossary.definition_id: Sistem koordinasi pelayanan kesehatan di mana pasien wajib diperiksa terlebih dahulu di fasilitas kesehatan tingkat pertama sebelum dirujuk ke rumah sakit spesialis.
multilingual_glossary.definition_zh: 按照分级诊疗原则，患者就诊应首先在基层社区医疗卫生机构首诊，确因病情需要再由全科医师开具转诊单上转至二级或三级综合医院。

country_specific_notes.CN: Mainland China promotes hierarchical diagnosis and treatment (分级诊疗) via Community Health Centers (社康中心) with higher reimbursement rates for local primary care.
country_specific_notes.ID: In Indonesian JKN, tiered referral (FKTP to FKRTL) is legally mandatory; specialist visits without valid electronic referral are completely non-reimbursable except for emergency room entries.

multilingual_glossary.authoritative_source: NHSA Graded Diagnosis Guideline & Permenkes No. 001 Tahun 2012
